source_deviations: Source lists seven areas in the order frontend, backend, database, mobile, cloud, UI/UX, infrastructure and DevOps with one sentence each; the lesson keeps only the seven names, regroups them into three sets by position in an application and writes its own explanation of each area (MDN for frontend, backend and database; general knowledge for the rest) instead of translating the source sentences.
Source image (a roadmap with named technologies) is not used, so no technology is named beyond HTML, CSS and JavaScript from MDN.
